author: Radhwankk
quote: The gameplay is amazing, but the story world feels very plain. From the very beginning, I felt like both of them would end up dying at the end. Also, Lucia's dominance over Jason is very annoying. It would have been much better if the story focused on Jason and his son—where Lucia dies in an accident after a few chapters, and Jason takes care of his son, working an ordinary job until the boy grows up and the world moves forward. Then, 20 years later, Jason and his son could get back into the game together; that would have created an incredible world. On top of that, the overly explicit sexual scenes ruined the experience. Because of all this, it wasn't anything amazing or unique for me. What a shame after all the hype and expectations.
